name: load-testing
description: Design and run load tests — tool selection (k6/Locust), test type strategy (smoke/load/stress/spike/soak), ramp-up curves, p50/p95/p99 targets, and threshold policy. Use when asked to "write a load test", "k6 script", "performance test", "check how many concurrent users", "find breaking point", "set SLO thresholds", or "load test this API". Do NOT use for: frontend Core Web Vitals (see web-performance skill). Do NOT use for: unit/integration test suites. Do NOT use for: security fuzzing.
